verdict.rationale: Exporting one's account data, such as returns, notices and payment history from MyFTB, in open formats is a capability a tax-agency portal could ship, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host) and says nothing about any data-export or portability feature. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none rather than na.
